privacyOverviewBody.message: TimeDash runs entirely in your browser. It has no analytics, telemetry, ads, or remote tracking. There are no accounts or servers logging your browsing history. Your data stays on your device and is processed using built-in browser storage APIs.

privacyDataStorageBody1.message: TimeDash saves your preferences and history in the browser's local storage API (chrome.storage.local). Nothing is written outside your browser profile. The extension stores:

privacyDataStorageItem1.message: Time tracking logs and per-domain history

privacyDataStorageItem3.message: Site blocking and daily restriction rules

privacyDataStorageBody2.message: This data is used only to display your usage stats and enforce your rules. No part of it is sent to external servers.

privacyNetworkActivityBody.message: TimeDash makes no outgoing network calls. Any network requests seen in DevTools come from your browser resolving site favicons or loading extension resources locally.

privacyPermissionsBody.message: TimeDash requests only the permissions needed to track time and enforce your rules:

privacyPermissionTabs.message: tabs: Reads active tab URLs to record time and apply site rules.

privacyPermissionScripting.message: scripting: Injects video speed controls into web video players.

privacyPermissionHost.message: host_permissions: Lets content scripts run on visited sites to track time and manage video playback.

privacyPermissionAlarms.message: alarms: Runs daily resets and optional data purges.

privacyPermissionNotifications.message: notifications: (Optional) Alerts you when daily time limits are reached.

privacyDataDeletionBody.message: You own your data. You can delete single domain records or wipe all data using the controls in Data Management above. Uninstalling TimeDash removes all stored extension data from your browser automatically.

privacyDataDeletionItem1.message: Click Delete All Data to wipe every record right away.

privacyDataDeletionItem2.message: Turn on Auto-purge Old Data to clear older records automatically.

privacyDataDeletionItem3.message: Use Delete Specific Data to search and delete records for a single domain.

privacyNoAccountBody.message: TimeDash requires no account, email, or cloud sync. All data lives on your device under your control.

privacyThirdPartyBody.message: TimeDash uses open-source libraries for development tooling only. The distributed extension contains no third-party tracking, analytics, or external SDKs.

privacyLicenseBody.message: TimeDash is released under the MIT License. You can use, modify, and share it freely under license terms. View the source on GitHub.

privacyContactBody.message: If you find a bug or have a privacy question, open an issue on GitHub with a description and any relevant screenshots.

helpTrackTimeBody.message: Time tracking runs automatically once enabled in <button class="quick-link inline-link" data-tab="general">General Settings</button>. Open the popup to see today's totals or visit <button class="quick-link inline-link" data-tab="analytics">Analytics</button> for charts and your activity heatmap.

helpBlockSiteBody.message: Go to , type the domain, and add it as a Blocked rule. The extension will redirect you to a block page whenever you visit that domain.

helpSetLimit.message: …set a daily time limit for a site?

helpSetLimitBody.message: Add the domain as a Restricted rule in . Set a time limit in minutes. Once exceeded for the day, the site will be blocked until the next day.

helpChangeSpeedBody.message: You can change the playback speed using one of the following ways:

helpChangeSpeedItem1.message: Use the keyboard shortcuts you've set up in the video controls tab. (Current: + / -, and .)

helpChangeSpeedItem2.message: Click on the extension icon to bring up the popup and use the + / -, and . buttons there.

helpChangeSpeedItem3.message: Change the speed from the video controls tab directly.

helpChangeThemeBody.message: Under , find the Appearance section. Pick light, dark, or auto theme and choose an accent color that fits your setup.

helpExportDataBody.message: Go to and use the Export Data button to save your usage and settings as a JSON file. Import that file later to restore your data on another profile or after a reinstall.

helpWhitelistDomainBody.message: Add the domain to the whitelist in <button class="quick-link inline-link" data-tab="privacy">Privacy & Data</button>. Time spent on whitelisted sites will not be recorded.

helpPauseTrackingBody.message: Toggle Pause Tracking in . No data will be collected while paused.

helpDeleteSpecificBody.message: Use the Search domain to delete data field in to find and remove records for individual domains.

helpPopupQuickActionsBody.message: Open the popup to see today's time and top sites. <kbd>Alt+T</kbd> toggles tracking on/off from any page. <kbd>Alt+B</kbd> blocks the current site immediately.

helpHeatmapDayBody.message: Click a day cell to see a breakdown of which sites you visited and for how long. Click again or press "Top Sites Today" to reset.

helpCustomAccentBody.message: In General Settings, click the + in the color picker to add any hex color.

helpWatchStorageBody.message: The Privacy tab has a storage meter and auto-purge settings to keep old data from piling up.

helpReportIssuesBody1.message: Bug reports and feature requests go to the GitHub Issues page.

helpReportIssuesBody2.message: When reporting a bug, include: the site URL, steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior, and your browser version. Screenshots help when the UI looks wrong. For video problems, mention whether the player is embedded in an iframe and paste any console errors you see.

helpReportIssuesBody3.message: For feature requests, a short description of what you want and why is enough to get things started.

helpSourceCodeBody.message: The full source is at github.com/intelligent-username/TimeDash. If you want to audit what the extension can access, start with manifest.json, then read the background scripts and content scripts.

helpPrivacyQuestionsBody.message: Read the full Privacy Policy on the Privacy & Data tab. If something doesn't match what you see in the browser, open an issue with details.

helpAboutBody.message: Version $1. Built as a vanilla JS extension with no frameworks and no external dependencies. All data stays on your device.
